note: Policy-level Kendall tau-b (policies with N>=1), raw tied data; naive count-average construction (B2); no CI computed.

definition: log(severity) ~ N + accident year + full covariates (OLS; policy-cluster bootstrap)
note: kendall_tau intentionally blank: the covariate-adjusted estimate is beta_N, an OLS coefficient on log severity (not a Kendall tau); ci_low/ci_high are the policy-cluster bootstrap 95% CI of beta_N (B=500). The unadjusted claim-level tau (previously repeated in this row) is in row FS_clean.

definition: payment delay × severity: mean settlement delay vs individual claim severity (claim level)
